target: 05 Technical architecture/Recovery Workbench API Specification v4.yaml

fixes.new:
DecisionRecordRef:
      type: object
      description: Reference to one written decision record. The fourth DecisionRecordRef element and the state of a written record whose downstream call timed out are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0831).
      properties:
        entryId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Entry ID of the decision record
        chainSeq:
          type: string
          description: Position of the entry in the hash chain
        outcome:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
          description: Cash, cure, loss and time, written when known
    RuleVersionApproval:
      type: object
      description: Approval of one rule package version. RW-RISK approves and the author cannot approve. Effective dating - the version becomes IN_FORCE on valid-from through RulePackageEffectiveDateJob.
      properties:
        versionId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Record identifier of the rule package version
        packageCode:
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
        versionLabel:
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
        validFrom:
          type: string
          format: date
          description: Date the version comes into force
        checklistState:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ChecklistItem'
          description: One ChecklistItem per item code of the change checklist
        decisionRecordReference:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/DecisionRecordRef'
        decisionRecordState:
          type: string
          description: Values Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0831)
        state:
          type: string
          description: Approval state of the version; values Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0831)
        approverReference:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: RW-RISK approver of the version
        approvedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the version was approved

disposition.note: Added RuleVersionApproval and DecisionRecordRef schemas; ChecklistItem referenced (existing schema, no item-code key). Unknown state values and 4th element marked GAP-0831.
